source: Counted 2026-11-01 (lane #167) from the landmark-brief.ts crops of the Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0): w07-160 (south hall front) and w13-70 (east gable over the podium).

facades.name: Hall south front: glazed wall
facades.note: One curtain of glazing between the banded brick corner piers. The heavier mullions every sixth bay (about 0.29 m on the photo's 2.23 m bay grid, the thin ones about 0.17 m) do not divide it, so it counts as one opening; the clock hangs in front of the eastern run.

facades.name: Hall east gable over the podium
facades.note: Stone gable field with vertical ribs between brick piers banded in white, one low-pitched peak, a louvre under the apex; no windows.
